seoTitle: How to Download the Asana Desktop App Easily
metaDescription: See how to download, install, and set up the official Asana desktop app for Windows or macOS in 2026, plus configure startup and shortcut preferences.
intro: Running Asana as a dedicated desktop window instead of another browser tab cuts down on clutter and speeds up loading. This guide walks through downloading the official installer for your operating system, completing setup, and configuring startup and notification preferences.

steps.heading: Go to the official Asana download page
steps.body: Access Asana's official website directly to find the desktop app links and avoid unverified third-party download sources.

steps.heading: Choose your operating system
steps.body: Select the correct installer package for Windows or macOS based on your machine's specifications.

steps.heading: Run the installer
steps.body: Open the downloaded installer file, execute the setup wizard, and grant the system permissions it requests.

steps.heading: Log in to your workspace
steps.body: Sign in through the secure web authentication flow to connect the desktop app to your existing Asana account and workspace.

steps.heading: Configure startup and shortcuts
steps.body: Set the app to launch automatically at boot and configure global keyboard shortcuts so you can capture new tasks from anywhere on your desktop.

faq.question: Is the Asana desktop app free?
faq.answer: Yes, the desktop app itself is free to download and use with any Asana account tier, since it's simply a native wrapper around the web platform.

faq.question: Does the desktop app work offline?
faq.answer: The app still requires an internet connection to sync your workspace, similar to using Asana in a browser.

faq.question: Can I use the same login on both desktop and web?
faq.answer: Yes, the desktop app uses the same secure web authentication as your browser account, so your data stays in sync across both.

faq.question: How do I set global keyboard shortcuts for quick task capture?
faq.answer: Open the app's preferences after installation and configure the global quick-add shortcut so it works even when Asana isn't the active window.
